name: DAX-02 Company Operations Agents - Daily Brief

parameters.jsCode:
const agents = [
  ['operations_director_agent', 'Coordinate daily priorities and blockers.'],
  ['content_strategy_agent', 'Choose topics and output mix across posts, videos, itineraries, merch, stickers, and designs.'],
  ['scriptwriting_agent', 'Create scripts, captions, CTAs, carousel copy, and product copy.'],
  ['video_production_agent', 'Package scripts, scenes, metadata, thumbnails, and video jobs for review.'],
  ['asset_management_agent', 'Track logos, images, videos, merch art, sticker art, and missing assets.'],
  ['publishing_scheduler_agent', 'Plan schedules only after manual approval and connected accounts.'],
  ['analytics_agent', 'Summarize performance and next tests.'],
  ['revenue_agent', 'Track affiliate, sponsorship, merch, and sticker revenue opportunities.'],
  ['community_agent', 'Plan replies, community prompts, and audience feedback loops.'],
  ['compliance_qa_agent', 'Check copyright, claims, safety, brand fit, and publishing readiness.'],
  ['platform_setup_agent', 'Track OAuth, domains, API scopes, policy pages, and account blockers.'],
  ['error_handler_agent', 'Record incidents, retry plans, and human escalations.']
];

return agents.map(([agentId, mission]) => ({
  json: {
    agentId,
    mission,
    status: 'ready_for_manual_use',
    publishAllowed: false,
    reviewStatus: 'manual_review_required',
    dailyQuestions: [
      'What is blocked?',
      'What can be safely produced today?',
      'What requires account login or approval?',
      'What needs QA before public release?'
    ],
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}));

parameters.content: Company operations agents for daily control. Produces briefs and gates only. No credentials. No publishing.
